{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders and remove QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
completed_orders_clean = sales[(sales['status'] == 'completed') & (sales['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99)]

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = completed_orders_clean['revenue_clean'].mean()

print(f"Mean revenue of completed orders (excluding QA orders): {mean_revenue:.2f}")

# Confirm the number of QA orders removed
print("Number of QA orders removed:", (sales['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99).sum())"}
